message:
As a grandparent, I've often found myself in the delightful yet challenging role of preparing my grandchildren for the unexpected. I remember a time when we practiced what to do in case of a fire, and their little eyes grew wide with curiosity. It's important to turn these moments into fun learning experiences, so our kids feel empowered instead of anxious. 

Sharing some great resources can help us navigate these conversations with ease and confidence. After all, preparedness is a team effort, and a little knowledge goes a long way in building resilience. What are some of your favorite ways to teach your kids about safety?
